execution_summary: The OLS regression was executed on the supplied county-level dataset, testing the hypothesis on the association between 2016 Trump vote share and changes in residents staying home during the specified periods. results.hypothesis_tested: Among sampled U.S. counties, a higher 2016 Trump vote share is associated with a lower percentage-point change in the share of residents staying home from the February 16–29, 2020 reference period to March 19–April 1, 2020, conditional on county covariates and state fixed effects.
